beats.what_happens: Trapped in the misty woods, Prince Cheon faces his attackers with growing desperation as they reveal their lethal intent to end his royal bloodline. Surrounded by assassins, he wonders what more they could possibly want from him after he already abandoned his dreams of the academy. One assassin grips his blade tight, declaring that as long as the prince has a claim to the throne, death is the only way out. They mock his lowly lineage and promise a painless end, for despite his peasant blood, his connection to a certain person makes him too dangerous to live.
beats.narration: Trapped in the mist and surrounded by blades, our boy is cornered. He's begging to know why they're hunting him after he quit the academy, but the assassins aren't having it. They say as long as he has a claim to the throne, he’s a target, even mocking his peasant bloodline. One of them even admits that waiting for him was almost boring enough to make them fall asleep. The hooded figure in the foreground holds a sword ready for combat while delivering a threat. The tension is thick as they finish making their point about his questionable lineage.
beats.emotional_turn: The assassins move from taunting his exhaustion to revealing a cold, calculated plan to execute him based solely on his royal bloodline.
beats.conflict_or_stakes: Prince Cheon's life is at stake as the assassins reveal that his very existence and lineage are the reasons for this assassination attempt.
beats.reveals_or_info: The assassins reveal that Prince Cheon's lack of martial talent is irrelevant because his right to the throne makes him a target.
beats.hook: His royal blood is a death sentence he can no longer outrun.
